cause: An inherited permission joined strategy and assessment under one ratification qualifier, although the source gives them different conditions.

permissions_exceptions: Strategy ownership explicitly included in the boundary's ratified responsibility permits strategy within that owned role and the actual grant.

An explicitly owned assessment boundary may publish assessment scores and laws within that responsibility and the actual grant; this exception adds no separate ratification requirement for assessment ownership.

same_cases.strategy: A governance-only observer gains no strategy authority. Explicitly ratified strategy ownership retains its exception within the actual grant.
same_cases.assessment: An explicitly assigned assessment boundary with its actual grant is not refused for lacking a separate strategy-style ratification.
same_cases.no_grant: Neither ownership nor evidence creates an absent operation grant.

standing: Author source-fidelity correction; frozen independent readback follows. No source law, acceptance criterion or owner decision changes.
